# --- IMPORTS ---
```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import spatialdata_io
import os

import xenium_align as xa
```

# --- PATHS ---
```{python Load }
# HE
HE_IMG_PATH = Path("HE.ome.tif")
HE_ADATA_PATH = Path("xenium_adata.h5ad")
# XENIUM
XE_DIR = Path("xenium_dir")
XE_IMG_PATH = xa.data.get_xenium_image_paths(XE_DIR)
# Output directory
output_dir = Path("./Xenium_HE_sarc_registration_results")
output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
# Deformation resolution
ms = 10
```

# --- LOAD IMAGES ---
```{python Load }
# --- SOURCE (H&E) ---
# Load hematoxylin
raw_he, meta_he = xa.data.load_downsampled_image(HE_IMG_PATH)
## Rewrite real spacing of HPS slide
TRUE_SPACING_UM = 0.3272900358604477
meta_he['orig_spacing_x'] = TRUE_SPACING_UM
meta_he['orig_spacing_y'] = TRUE_SPACING_UM
meta_he['spacing'] = (
    TRUE_SPACING_UM * meta_he['scale_x'], 
    TRUE_SPACING_UM * meta_he['scale_y']
)
he_proc = xa.data.prepare_he(raw_he)

# --- TARGET (Xenium) ---
# Load DAPI
XE_IMG_PATH_DAPI = XE_IMG_PATH.pop("DAPI")
dapi, meta_xe = xa.data.load_downsampled_image(XE_IMG_PATH_DAPI)
channels_raw = {"DAPI": dapi}
offset_x, offset_y = xa.data.calculate_pyramidal_offset(XE_IMG_PATH_DAPI, meta_xe)
# Load other channels
channels_raw.update({
    name: xa.data.load_downsampled_image(path)[0] 
    for name, path in XE_IMG_PATH.items()
})
channels_proc, combos = xa.data.prepare_xe_generate_combination(channels_raw)
# Define the composite image to match
combo_name = 'DAPI_ATP1A'
channels_to_combine = combos[combo_name]
xe_proc = xa.data.combine_xenium_channels(channels_proc, channels_to_combine)
```


# --- REGISTRATION ---
```{python Registration}
combo_dir = os.path.join(output_dir, combo_name)
if not os.path.exists(combo_dir): os.makedirs(combo_dir)


fixed = xa.data.get_sitk_image(he_proc, meta_he)
moving = xa.data.get_sitk_image(xe_proc, meta_xe)
# Visualize initial overlap
xa.plot.single_overlay(fixed, moving, combo_dir, "initial.png")
# Run registration
moving_rigid, tx_rigid, moving_bspline, tx_bspline = xa.module.run_registration(fixed, moving, combo_dir, ms)
# Visualize results
xa.plot.registration_summary(fixed, moving, moving_rigid, moving_bspline, combo_dir, ms)
xa.plot.local_deformations(fixed, tx_bspline, combo_dir, ms)
```

# --- TRANSFORM CELLS ---
```{python}
## Load proseg segmentations (adata) and save them as .geojson
gdf_xe_pixels = xa.data.load_xenium_adata(HE_ADATA_PATH, meta_xe, combo_dir)
## Transform cells from gdf to .geojson
gdf_he = xa.module.transform_xenium_adata_to_he(gdf_xe_pixels, meta_he, meta_xe, combo_dir, ox=offset_x, oy=offset_y, ms)
```
